astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0: listing, answering, verifying and reading cost nothing
astranl.do_not_use_when: you want an estimate yourself (estimate_cost) or a task executed (create_task)
astranl.example_intent: Which tile adhesive and tiling requests are open in postcode area 3?
astranl.next_possible_action: rfq_respond with rfq_id and priced lines
astranl.proof_level: each RFQ carries rfq_sha256 and an open_receipt alk_ id
astranl.returns: open RFQs with lines, region class, deadline, licence required; outreach state
astranl.use_when: you sell or install building products or work in the Netherlands and want to see what AstraNL customers need priced

description: Open AstraNL requests for prices (RFQ) for Dutch building jobs: anonymised lines with spec, CPV or ETIM code where known, unit, quantity, region class and deadline, derived from real AstraNL estimates. No customer data. Suppliers, wholesalers, manufacturers and contractors who want to quote answer with rfq_respond. AstraNL contacts nobody; an empty list is an honest zero.

include_synthetic.description: true also lists labelled synthetic test RFQs

region_class.description: NL-PC1-1 to NL-PC1-9 (first postcode digit) or NL

rfq_id.description: one RFQ id (RFQ-...); without it the open RFQs are listed

name: rfq_list
